title: PG-08.1 Scope One lifecycle gaps (intake to delivery) (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP08 in memev: Scope One lifecycle gaps (intake to delivery). Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP08.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP07-03, WP10-03. Depends on contracts: SO-1.04, SO-1.10, SO-1.11, SO-2.08. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-1.04, SO-1.10 and SO-1.11: WP08-02 builds what SO-1.04 decides (the adapter contract) and WP08-03 builds the SO-1.11 steps that the signed SO-11-A loop does not name; the decision records are cited by requirement number and not restated. Boundary with SO-2.08: SO-2.08 holds the adapter and capability mapping for each framework and runtime; WP08-02 is the base execution adapter contract those adapters implement. Signed vault contract SO-11-A (cited by id only): the loop test with two stub sessions over the MCP stdio path, the failure matrix mapping, the load test and the invariant checker: WP08-03 reuses it and specifies only the SO-1.11 steps it does not name. Signed vault contract SO-05-B (cited by id only): per-client capability records: the adapter contract reads them and defines no second record. Signed vault contract SO-08-B (cited by id only): pause, resume, cancel and recovery through the capability record: the adapter contract carries the cancellation semantics it reads. Build layer (owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the unsigned fold (SO-A-01 to SO-A-12, SO-R-E, SO-F-01 to SO-F-13, cited by id only) is the build layer, and it overlaps this spec at SO-A-03, SO-A-10. This spec will cite those ids and keep only what the fold does not cover; trim pending fold PR (the final fold ids come in a separate pull request, branch contracts/scope-one-fold-build-layer). Nothing is trimmed yet. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.title: Provider-neutral execution adapter contract: the module and its conformance test (the gaps SO-1.04, SO-05-B and SO-08-B leave open)
requirements: MV-S1-05: Provider-neutral execution adapters: discovery, session lifecycle, dispatch, checkpoint, progress, cancellation, recovery. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:112; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:137; baseline 8.2)

SO-1.04 requirement 1: "Define one adapter contract with declared capabilities, identity, session discovery, dispatch, progress/result reporting, checkpointing, cancellation semantics and recovery." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)

SO-1.04 requirement 2: "Keep provider-specific behaviour inside adapters; the planner and coordinator must consume capability declarations rather than provider-specific conditionals." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)
SO-1.04 requirement 4: "Never report successful completion merely because a provider returned a success-shaped response." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Specifies only what is not already specified. SO-1.04 decides the contract but is a design record and builds nothing; the per-client capability records are signed vault contract SO-05-B and the cancellation flow is signed vault contract SO-08-B (both cited by id; neither is delivered on main). This task builds the execution adapter contract module and the suite that any adapter must pass, reads capability from the SO-05-B record and defines no second record, and leaves the event distinction (SO-1.04 requirement 3) and the pause and cancel flow to those contracts. SO-2.08 holds the adapter for each framework and runtime that implements this contract. Trim pending fold PR: the unsigned fold SO-A-03 overlaps this task.

criteria.statement: The adapter contract tests are red on the base and green after
All eight named conformance tests are present

verifier.cmd: for n in "adapter contract: declares capabilities, identity and session discovery" "adapter contract: dispatch is accepted, not completed" "adapter contract: progress and result reporting" "adapter contract: checkpoint and recovery" "adapter contract: unsupported cancellation is reported unsupported, never confirmed" "adapter contract: a success-shaped response is not completion" "adapter contract: capability declarations, not provider conditionals, drive the coordinator" "adapter contract: two stub adapters pass the same conformance suite"; do grep -qF "$n" test/adapter-contract.test.mjs || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The named conformance tests run and pass
docs/ADAPTERS.md names the six contract parts of SO-1.04 requirement 1 that are not capability records

verifier.cmd: for n in discovery dispatch checkpoint progress cancellation recovery; do grep -qi "$n" docs/ADAPTERS.md || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The contract module never branches on a provider or client name, so provider-specific behaviour stays in adapters
Committed and pushed on its own branch for review; nothing is pushed to main

tasks.title: Lifecycle test: the SO-1.11 steps that the signed end-to-end loop does not name (blocker, revoked permission, conflicting edit, final report with receipts)
requirements: MV-S1-01: Outcome-to-delivery lifecycle: intake and scope, formal spec with approvals, contracts and work packages, resource choice, coordinated execution with recovery, verification against the original requirements, delivery with evidence and limits. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:108; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:133; baseline 8.2)

MV-S1-02: PMO-grade project workspace and a persistent lead-agent interface over canonical state. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:109; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:134; baseline 8.2)
SO-1.11 requirement 9: "A genuine blocker requiring human judgement is raised; the lead agent explains options, records the user's choice and updates affected work." (source: contract SO-1.11 T1)
SO-1.11 requirement 11: "Revoke a required permission and confirm Memev safely pauses or reroutes affected work, then asks the user only if a new grant is necessary." (source: contract SO-1.11 T1)
SO-1.11 requirement 14: "Reconcile a conflicting edit without silently losing work." (source: contract SO-1.11 T1)
SO-1.11 requirement 15: "Produce a final report linking delivered artefacts, checks, evidence, decisions and outstanding limitations." (source: contract SO-1.11 T1)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Specifies only the gap. The loop (two stub sessions over the MCP stdio path, disconnect recovery, a failed check, a scope amendment, pause and resume, a verified delivery summary), the concurrency load test, the baseline comparison and the no-false-verified invariant checker are signed vault contract SO-11-A (acceptance criteria 1 to 5, test/scope-one-e2e.test.mjs; cited by id, not delivered on main) and are not repeated here. SO-1.11 is the design record of the journey, SO-1.10 the fault classes. This test adds the SO-1.11 steps the loop does not name: requirements 9, 11, 14 and 15. Requirements 1 and 2 (connections) belong to SO-1.06, requirement 8 (the workspace) to SO-1.05 and requirement 16 (other configurations) is recorded in the SO-1.11 record. Trim pending fold PR: the unsigned fold SO-A-10 overlaps this task.

criteria.statement: The lifecycle test is red on the base and green after
